scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Assistance For Marble, IT & ITES, Electric Vehicles & Spare Parts, Toys Units And Semi-Conduct or Industries Sectors
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The unit must be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Commercial production must have commenced between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
The enterprise must apply through the online portal within one year from the date of eligibility
benefits_summary: Provides a credit‑linked interest subsidy of up to 60% per annum (capped at ₹5 million) and a capital investment subsidy of up to 20% for small units (capped at ₹5 million) or 15% for large semiconductor units (capped at ₹7.5 million).
